author: Harry John
message: The inverter stopped working completely and there is no power output at all.

author: Emily Elizabeth
message: Can you please check if battery connections are fine?

author: Harry John
message: The connections look fine but the inverter display stays dark and unresponsive.

author: Emily Elizabeth
message: It sounds like the inverter unit itself has failed. We will arrange a replacement inverter.

author: Harry John
message: The new inverter is installed and power output is back to normal. Thank you!

author: Harry John
message: It is a bright sunny day but the system delivers no current at all.

author: Emily Elizabeth
message: Can you please check if there are any loose connections?

author: Harry John
message: A battery terminal and one wiring connector both looked loose near the junction box.

author: Emily Elizabeth
message: Please tighten the loose connections and measure the current again.

author: Harry John
message: After tightening the loose connections the current is flowing again.

author: Sunny Sunshine
message: One of the solar panels is broken and there is a visible crack across the glass.

author: Sunny Sunshine
message: Please check why the solar panel is broken

author: Bradley Flowers
message: The cracked solar panel now produces almost no power.

author: Bradley Flowers
message: A broken solar panel cannot be repaired
column6: so we will schedule a replacement panel.

author: Sunny Sunshine
message: There is a strange buzzing noise every time I switch off the inverter.

author: Sunny Sunshine
message: It is a loud humming and clicking sound coming from the inverter housing.

author: Bradley Flowers
message: That clicking is likely the relay inside the inverter
